## Description
Provide a concise summary of the changes proposed in this Pull Request and the problem/feature being addressed.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking addition to language, compiler, or standard library)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature modifying syntax or behavior)
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Tooling / Build / CI update

## Verification & Testing
Describe the tests added or executed to verify your changes:
- [ ] Unit tests added in `tests/`
- [ ] Full regression suite executed (`python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"`)
- [ ] CLI smoke tests executed (`vakya test`)
- [ ] Differential testing verified (VM vs Interpreter)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's formatting and style standards
- [ ] I have commented complex sections of code
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation in `docs/`
- [ ] All new and existing tests passed cleanly
